Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, Dave Stevers <daves...@HOTMAIL.COM> writes:
> Over the course of an action, can mask of 1000 faces be used more than
> once? From GIlbert to dimple, to carlotta ... even back to GIlbert?

Yes. Each vampire (with Obf) can play a Mask.

> Can Rotschreck be used on agg. weather control, (Dawn op.)

No. Weather Control's damage is not considered to be inflicted by
either minion - it is just "environmental" damage.

> How about
> pulled fangs?

Yes.

> Also if I dawn op an action, play drawing out the beast,
> the opposing minion doesn't prevent my strike for 1 hand,
> and I prevent his strike, can I then play pulled fang even if he's on
> his way to torpor?

Yes.
